rows.answer: In Team TS3008, Speaker A pushed back on adding an LCD display. The objection was that an LCD display would not fit the team's philosophy of simplicity and would be too fragile, adding nothing to the design while conflicting with the sturdy, user-friendly plastic and rubber materials they wanted. The final design did not have an LCD display.
rows.gold: Speaker A objected that an LCD did not fit the sturdy, throwable plastic-and-soft-rubber design they were after (Speaker D agreed it is fragile), while Speaker B argued it was up to the market if it was trendy. The final design had no LCD.
